name: Alabama's Fall Festival and Pumpkin Patch
venue: 4D Farm, 7066 County Road 703
summary: Pumpkins, hayrides, a corn maze, rides, farm animals and food. It's a fall outing many Cullman County families look forward to.

name: Scarecrow Trail at Heritage Park
venue: Heritage Park, 1705 Lee Avenue SW
summary: Walk through creative scarecrow displays by local businesses, churches, schools and neighbors. Proceeds from exhibit registrations support the Cullman Area Literacy Council.

name: Sawdust Jukebox Live at Goat Island Brewing
venue: Goat Island Brewing, The Original, 1646 John Cooper Drive SE
summary: Sawdust Jukebox plays four hours of classic and 90s country at Goat Island's original taproom. Red Door Deli serves food from 5 to 9:30 p.m. Bring your boots.

name: Berlin Trunk or Treat
venue: Berlin Farmers Market, 50 Mt. Carmel Drive
summary: Full size candy bars from the Town of Berlin and free bounce houses for the kids. Every trunk bay is now filled, many by local churches. Parking questions go to the Berlin town clerk at 256-736-3138 before the event.

name: Camp-O-Ween at Smith Lake Park
venue: Smith Lake Park, 403 County Road 386
summary: Food trucks, games, contests, rides, a DJ and campground trick or treating make Halloween at Smith Lake Park a full day outing.

name: Drive Through Trick or Treat
venue: Hanceville Fire Station #1, 119 Collins Street
summary: For the sixth year, Hanceville firefighters and EMTs are handing out candy to kids who stay in the car. Costumes are encouraged, and seatbelts are required.

name: Nightmare on Woodland Street
venue: Woodland Street NW
summary: Families along Woodland Street NW team up every Halloween with interactive props, plenty of candy and a whole street full of spooky fun.

name: Retro Rock Revival Live at Goat Island Brewing
venue: Goat Island Brewing, The Original, 1646 John Cooper Drive SE
summary: Retro Rock Revival brings a Halloween night rock show to Goat Island's original taproom. Papa Sam's Hotdogs serves food from 5 to 10:30 p.m.

name: Halloween Night at the Cullman Elks Lodge
time: Doors open 6:00 PM, music at 8:00 PM
venue: Cullman Elks Lodge, 1525 Brantley Ave NW
summary: Candy, a costume contest and live music from the Sipsey Falls Band make for a fun Halloween night out at the Elks Lodge.

name: Harvest at the Park in Baileyton
venue: Baileyton Town Park, 390 Fire Station Road
summary: Baileyton throws its first Harvest at the Park with live music, costume contests for kids and pets, bounce houses, carnival games, sack races and pickleball. A full day of Halloween fun for the whole family.

name: Halloween at Baileyton Drag Strip
time: Gates 8:00 AM, time trials 10:00 AM, trick or treat in the pits from 4:30 PM
venue: Baileyton Drag Strip, 1500 Summit Road
summary: Spend Halloween at the track. Time trials start at 10 AM, and kids can trick or treat in the pits starting at 4:30 PM, along with a costume contest.

name: Events and Community Development Committee Meeting
venue: Shirley Burden Public Library, 201 Commercial St
cost: Free and open to the public
summary: The city's events committee plans community events and works on tourism and local partnerships. Residents with ideas are welcome to come.

name: An Evening with Poe at Jubilee Kitchen and Bar
time: Cocktail hour 5:00 PM, readings at 6:00 PM
venue: Jubilee Kitchen and Bar, 515 Fourth St. SW
host: Jubilee Kitchen and Bar and the Cullman County Public Library
cost: Reservations required through Jubilee; 21 and older
summary: Hear readings of The Tell-Tale Heart, The Raven, The Black Cat and The Cask of Amontillado in the dining room of the historic Flying Fifty Hotel. Seats need a reservation, and cancellations inside 48 hours cost $35 per person.

name: General Election Day
venue: Cullman County polling places (find yours on AlabamaVotes.gov)
host: Alabama Secretary of State and Cullman County Probate Office
cost: Free; bring a valid photo ID
summary: Polls are open 7 AM to 7 PM for the Nov. 3 general election. Cullman County ballots carry state races, four statewide amendments and a local question on a property tax break for qualifying seniors. Find your polling place and sample ballot on AlabamaVotes.gov.

name: Short Story Writing Workshop at the Cullman County Public Library
venue: Cullman County Public Library, 200 Clark Street NE
summary: A free writing workshop for adults and students in grade 5 and up, held during the library's November short story challenge. Pick up prompts and entry sheets for stories of 1,000 to 5,000 words, due by Nov. 25.

name: The Link of Cullman County Annual Gala
venue: Cotton Creek Warehouse, 417 3rd Ave SW
cost: Tables and sponsorships through The Link
summary: The Link's yearly fundraising gala brings a silent auction, a plated dinner with dessert, and thanks for the volunteers and partners who help Cullman County families. Doors open at 5:30 PM.

name: Wallace State Men's Basketball vs. Snead State
venue: Wallace State
summary: The Lions play Snead State. Check the official schedule for the location and any time changes before you go.

name: Much Ado About Nothing at Wallace State
venue: Betty Leeth Haynes Theatre, Wallace State, 801 Main Street NW
cost: $10 donation for adults, $5 for students and children under 12
summary: Wallace State Theatre sets Shakespeare's comedy in the World War II era, with the music and dances of the time.

name: 16th Annual Mud Creek Arts and Crafts Festival
venue: Historic Downtown Hanceville, 106 Commercial St NE
summary: Downtown Hanceville turns into a free street fair with handmade goods, food trucks, kids activities and shops open along Commercial Street. It goes on rain or shine.

name: Cipollari Live: A Fundraiser for the Randy Travis Foundation
venue: Terri Pines Country Club, 700 Pine Hill Dr
summary: Hanceville's own Cipollari, a bluegrass band of six siblings, plays a free benefit concert for the Randy Travis Foundation, which supports arts and music for kids. Grab free tickets through the link in the source article.

name: Cullman Veterans Day Celebration
venue: Cullman Regional Airport
summary: Warbirds, skydivers, military flyovers, living history and special guest Mike Durant, all to honor our veterans. The celebration goes on rain or shine.

name: Holly Pond Lions Club Pancake Breakfast
venue: Holly Pond Lions Club Building, Lyons Park Road
summary: Pancakes, bacon, sausage and coffee or juice, to eat in or take out. Proceeds help the Lions Club project fund and the food pantry between Town Hall and the fire department.

name: Wallace State Men's Basketball vs. Itawamba
venue: Wallace State
summary: The Lions play Itawamba. Check the official schedule for the location and any time changes before you go.

name: Grace Concert Series: Madison City Community Orchestra
venue: Grace Episcopal Church, 305 Arnold Street NE
summary: Violinist Rachel Wyatt, a former Grace member, joins the Madison City Community Orchestra for a free one hour program called Strings Through the Ages in the church nave.

name: Salute to United States Veterans Concert
venue: Betty Leeth Haynes Theatre, Wallace State, 801 Main Street NW
host: Wallace State Concert Band and Jazz Band
summary: Patriotic music from the Wallace State bands, the hymns of each branch of the Armed Forces and a moment to honor veterans in the audience.

name: Veterans Day
venue: Hanceville City Hall, 112 Main St SE
summary: Veterans Day is marked on the city calendar. If you need to visit City Hall that day, call ahead at (256) 352-9830 to check whether offices are open.

name: Hanceville City Council Meeting
time: 6:00 PM work session, regular meeting right after
venue: Hanceville City Hall, 112 Main St SE
cost: Free and open to the public
summary: The City Council holds a work session at 6:00 PM, followed right away by its regular meeting. The city announced this date on its Oct. 8 agenda.

name: United Way Designer Bag Bingo
venue: Cotton Creek, 417 Third Ave SW
summary: An evening of bingo with designer handbag prizes. Proceeds support local needs and programs through United Way of Cullman County.

name: Cullman Christmas Open House
host: Cullman Area Chamber of Commerce and Visitor Center
summary: Holiday shopping kicks off with store specials, a cookie crawl, visits with Santa and a window display contest.

name: Lion's Pride Fall VEX IQ Robotics Tournament
venue: Wallace State Community College, 801 Main St NW
cost: Free to watch; team registration through VEX
summary: Elementary and middle school robotics teams from across Alabama bring their VEX IQ robots to Wallace State for a full day of qualifying matches, skills runs, finals and awards. Doors and pits open at 8:00 AM, matches start at 9:15 AM, and finals begin around 3:00 PM.

name: Wallace State Men's Basketball vs. Albany Tech
venue: Wallace State
summary: The Lions play Albany Tech. Check the official schedule for the location and any time changes before you go.

name: Wallace State Men's Basketball vs. East Mississippi
venue: Wallace State
summary: The Lions play East Mississippi. Check the official schedule for the location and any time changes before you go.

name: Cullman County Commission Work Session and Meeting
venue: Cullman County Courthouse, Commission Meeting Room, 500 2nd Ave SW
cost: Free and open to the public
summary: The work session starts at 4:00 PM and the regular commission meeting follows at 6:00 PM. It is the first regular meeting with the new District 1 and District 2 commissioners.

name: Cullman Veterans Hall of Fame Dinner and Ceremony
venue: Loft 212, 212 Fourth St SW
summary: This year's class of inductees will be honored at a dinner and ceremony. The event was moved to this new date, and ticket details are coming soon.

name: Hanceville Bulldogs Basketball vs. Ardmore
venue: Hanceville High School
summary: The Bulldogs host Ardmore in the Hanceville High gym. Bring the family and wear your purple.

name: Cullman Christkindlmarkt
time: Thursday to Saturday 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM; Sunday 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM; open every day from Dec. 10
venue: Depot Park, 107 Arnold St NW
summary: A German style Christmas market in downtown Cullman with more than 40 vendors, German inspired food, an ice skating rink, a Ferris wheel and snow tubing. Closed Monday through Wednesday until Dec. 10, and closed Thanksgiving Day.

name: Run Run Rudolph at Winter Wonderland
venue: Sportsman Lake Park, 1544 Sportsman Lake Rd NW
summary: Run or stroll through the Winter Wonderland Christmas lights on foot, one night only. Registration opens at 4:00 PM, runners start at 5:00 PM and walkers follow. There's an ugly sweater and Christmas costume contest, dogs and strollers are welcome, and kids 6 and under are free. Park at the fairgrounds.

name: Christmas at the Grotto
time: Nov. 19 to 22, Nov. 27 to 29, Dec. 3 to 6, Dec. 10 to 23 and Dec. 26 to 27; 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM Monday to Saturday, 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM Sunday; lights on at 5:00 PM
venue: Ave Maria Grotto, 1600 St. Bernard Dr SE
cost: Adults $12, seniors and teens $10, kids 5 to 12 and military $9, under 4 free
summary: Brother Joseph Zoettl's miniature shrines glow under holiday lights with music, food and family fun. Santa, $7 horse drawn wagon rides, live music and food trucks are planned for the special weekend of Dec. 11 and 12.

name: Christkindlmarkt Parade and Tree Lighting
venue: Downtown Cullman and Depot Park, 107 Arnold St NW
summary: Floats, local bands and community groups parade through downtown at 6:30 PM, then the tree lighting at Depot Park starts at 8:00 PM with a light show, fireworks and a new Christmas drone show. Rain date is Saturday, Nov. 21.

name: Wallace State Women's Basketball: Wallace State Classic vs. Vincennes
venue: Wallace State
summary: The Wallace State Lions women's basketball team hosts Vincennes in the Wallace State Classic.

name: Vinemont Band Booster Winter Craft Show
time: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Nov 20; 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM Nov 21
venue: Cullman Church of Christ, 4345 Alabama Highway 157
summary: Get a head start on Christmas shopping with local craft and food vendors, from handmade gifts to fresh sourdough, while supporting the Vinemont High School Marching Eagle Band.

name: The Nutcracker with Ballet South
time: 2:00 PM and 7:00 PM Nov 21; 2:00 PM Nov 22
venue: Betty Leeth Haynes Theatre, Wallace State, 801 Main Street NW
summary: Ballet South brings its yearly Nutcracker to Wallace State, following Clara's dream through the Land of Sweets.

name: Wallace State Women's Basketball: Wallace State Classic vs. Chipola
venue: Wallace State
summary: The Lions women's basketball team wraps up the Wallace State Classic at home against Chipola.

name: Festival of Trees at the Cullman Wellness and Aquatic Center
time: Opening ceremony Dec. 3 at 5:00 PM; trees on display Dec. 4 to 27 during regular center hours
venue: Cullman Wellness and Aquatic Center, 1636 Field of Miracles Drive SW
summary: Christmas trees decorated by students from local public and private schools and the Cullman County Public Library fill the CWAC foyer. Judging is Dec. 3 at 1 p.m. with the opening ceremony at 5 p.m.

summary: The Bulldogs host Good Hope in the Hanceville High gym. Bring the family and wear your purple.

summary: An indoor holiday market with handmade gifts, boutiques, crafts and holiday treats. Get your Christmas shopping done close to home.

summary: Step inside some of Cullman's most beautifully decorated homes during this holiday tradition that goes back to 1986. Every dollar raised helps the Bonnie Heatherly Memorial Scholarship, Good Samaritan Health Clinic, Hospice of Cullman and Restoring Women's Outreach.
